row.title: Perform risk-based audits of the PV system and its quality system
row.statement: The pharmaceutical industry (MAH) shall perform audits of its pharmacovigilance systems, including risk-based audits of its quality systems, covering all areas listed in the guideline and focusing on the areas of highest risk, with risk to public health of prime importance.

row.quote:
i.   Audit findings shall be reported in line with their relative risk level and
        shall be graded in order to indicate their relative criticality to risks
        impacting the pharmacovigilance system, processes and parts of
        processes. The grading system shall be defined in the description of
        the quality system for pharmacovigilance. The findings shall be
        documented in an audit report and shall be communicated to
        management in a timely manner and issues that need to be addressed

        conducted.
 iii.   The marketing authorization holder shall place a note concerning

row.statement: PV audits shall be conducted by individuals with no direct involvement in or responsibility for the matters audited; audit activities shall be independent and auditors free from interference in scoping, performing and reporting audits.

row.statement: When the MAH becomes aware of a sale suspension, recall or equivalent measure (including measures on fatal cases) by a foreign government or a foreign authorised manufacturer/importer, it shall report it to MFDS within 3 days of becoming aware, with its background, content and characteristics; the domestic action plan may be reported within 7 days.

row.title: Classify AEs/ADRs as serious using the KGCP seriousness criteria
row.statement: For clinical trial safety reporting, the sponsor must treat as serious any AE or ADR occurring at any dose of the investigational product that results in death or is life-threatening, requires or prolongs hospitalisation, causes permanent or significant disability or functional impairment, causes a foetal malformation or abnormality, or is another medically important event such as drug dependence or abuse or blood disorders.
